chapter: Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around
act_title: Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around

quests.title: Another Auspicious Moonlit Night Rolls Around

dialogue.t: Wow, Yilong Wharf sure is busy today! Is there an event going on or something?
{NICKNAME}, Paimon, over here!
Xiangling!
Hehe, look at the calendar! It's time for this year's Moonchase Festival.
Ohh, right! Paimon almost forgot, haha! So, does that mean the Masterful Chefs competition is back?
Not exactly, things are a little different this year...
Masterful Chefs, is it? Hmm... Intriguing. Liyue hosts culinary contests like that?
Escoffier!
Wait... Were you specially invited to join the Masterful Chefs competition as some super-powerful outside challenger, the ultimate boss for all of Liyue's chefs to take on?
Huh, that does sound rather appealing...
Nope, that's not it at all! We're not even holding another round of Masterful Chefs! Instead, there's an event called the "World Food Fair."
Representatives from Mondstadt, Fontaine, and Sumeru have all come to take part. Ms. Escoffier is here as the representative of Fontaine's culinary scene.
World Food Fair?
Yep! It's a chance to try amazing food from four different nations all in one place! I knew you wouldn't wanna miss out, so I wrote you a letter.
You know it! This kind of event is Paimon's jam!
The event's already underway, and I still have a stall to run, so I won't be able to show you around. But if you ever start craving something good, drop by and try what I've been cooking up!
My own offerings for the fair this time aren't to be missed either. Do come by and sample them.
Woohoo!
Miss Xiangling, I found the culinary insights you shared earlier most inspiring. Would you mind if I wrote everything down?
Oh, come on, you're making it sound so serious! I was just thinking out loud...
Wow, Xiangling and Escoffier in the same kitchen... Just imagine how good the food would be...

dialogue.sit: This year's Moonchase Festival does feel different.

dialogue.t: Yeah, Paimon would never have guessed it'd be at Yilong Wharf before we came! Much less that they'd get rid of Masterful Chefs and add a food fair...

Well, the elders of the clan probably figured that between Yilong Wharf's connections to other nations and the timing of Moonchase, holding an international event rooted in the festival's culinary traditions was just the thing to do.
It's a great way to bring in visitors from all over the world, and hopefully give the locals a bit of an economic boost, too.
Lan Yan — and Ningguang too! Long time no see!
It has been a while, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

dialogue.sit: What were you saying just now, Lan Yan?

dialogue.t: I guess you haven't heard yet. Chenyu Vale's associations are in charge of organizing this year's Moonchase Festival events.
My clan carries a lot of weight there, so our elders worked out the format we're going with this year.
Oh, so that's what happened! Well, it was a really good call!
But is it really okay not to have Masterful Chefs? Paimon always thought that was a really important tradition...
You needn't worry. Moonchase has always been shaped, first and foremost, by the people.

Over the course of Liyue's history, many new customs have gradually been folded into the Moonchase Festival celebrations, only later to be regarded as "tradition." Masterful Chefs is but one example of such.
There have never been any official rules dictating the Moonchase festivities. Most of them began with the people themselves.
Perhaps in time, this "World Food Fair" will become a new tradition.
So you and Lan Yan came to enjoy the festival too, right? Hmm... Wait, then why'd you bring the Millelith?
As a matter of fact, this visit to Yilong Wharf is official business.
Around this time each year, malevolent forces tend to gather, stirring up trouble across Liyue. Their energy can possess monsters, making them far more dangerous than usual.
The Millelith have already mobilized. My reason for coming is to coordinate their efforts with those of the Lan clan.
Lan Yan was just taking me to meet with the clan elder when we happened to spot you.
The Millelith are working with Lan Yan's family?
Precisely. Lan Yan belongs to a renowned old thaumaturge clan. I trust you've heard of the thaumaturges of Liyue before?
Liyue is home to many gifted individuals who study the mystical arts. Whether learned from adepti or born of their own insights, they preserve and pass them down from generation to generation.
These practitioners are known as "thaumaturges." The founder of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, the Wuwang Kid, and the ancestor of the Lan clan, the Wind Reader, are two notable examples.
The arts practiced by these thaumaturges are quite formidable. Thus, when ill winds gather and evil spirits stir, they play an important role in safeguarding the land and its people.
Ohhh, Paimon gets it! Sounds like Lan Yan's family is the real deal! But, uh, about those evil spirits...
Liyue enjoys the protection of the Adepti, certainly, but that is no reason for us mortals to sit idly by, dependent upon them.
Moreover, with evil spirits being so much more active at this time of year, even they must grow weary... All the more reason for us to do our part.
And so, it is customary for the Millelith to join forces with civilian thaumaturges during this season.

If there is nothing else, I'm afraid I must take my leave. When you have time, do come to the Jade Chamber so we can catch up properly. You will find I have prepared the finest tea and refreshments to receive you.

dialogue.sit: Anything we can do to help?

dialogue.t: That's right, we can help too!
{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I thank you for your kind offer. But I would rather you enjoy the holiday, as any other ordinary festivalgoer might.
Together, the Millelith and thaumaturges are more than capable of handling these troublesome spirits. They have done so for many years.
Well, if you say so... okay.
Then I should get going too. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, don't forget to have a wonderful Moonchase Festival!
Lady Ningguang, this way, please.

quests.description: The two of you receive a letter from Xiangling, inviting you to Yilong Wharf...
